expected.text: I have received a message on whatapp that is part of an ongoing harassment. In a separate incident, I also received messages that were sexual harassment (a man I didn’t know asking me for photos of my naked body). Both times I reported it to WhatsApp straight away. The first time it happened I then tried to reported it to the group the man tried to get my number from to get him removed from the group. The group asked for evidence, and I couldn’t find the messages. The second time it happened, I needed to take a screen shot to get the person prosecuted with local authorities. And I couldn’t find the message. I have since realised whatsapp must delete messages if you report the person. The moral of the story? Don’t report to WhatsApp because nothing happens from their end and you’ll lose the messages.I’m guessing that WhatsApp will say they do it for your safety, but the truth is they don’t want people to have screen shots of bad messages sent on their platform. It doesn’t make me safer not being able to report the messages to the group or to the police. I contacted WhatsApp with a polite message requesting access to the message I received so I could report it to local authorities. The WhatsApp support was so unhelpful I was flabbergasted. I think this is a really dangerous feature and users should be made very aware of it in case it happens to them. It’s happened to me twice now and I’m just a normal nice person, so I think it’s a pretty common occurrence.
